tools.name: cancel_paid_seat_with_refund
tools.description: Cancels a paid workspace seat by deleting its Stripe subscription item and removing the seat and its assignment from the workspace. If requested, it also refunds the unused portion of the seat's last charge to the card on file.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: ID of the workspace that owns the seat.

params.name: seat_id
params.description: ID of the paid seat to cancel.

params.name: refund_unused
params.description: Whether to refund the unused prorated amount of the last charge. Defaults to true.

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ.get("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY", "")
DB_PATH = os.environ.get("TEAMCHAT_DB_PATH", "/var/lib/teamchat/workspace.db")


@tool
def cancel_paid_seat_with_refund(workspace_id: str, seat_id: str, refund_unused: bool = True) -> dict:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT stripe_subscription_item_id, stripe_charge_id, unused_cents, currency "
            "FROM paid_seats WHERE workspace_id = ? AND seat_id = ?",
            (workspace_id, seat_id),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return {"status": "not_found", "workspace_id": workspace_id, "seat_id": seat_id}

        stripe.SubscriptionItem.delete(
            row["stripe_subscription_item_id"],
            proration_behavior="none",
        )

        refund_id = None
        refunded_cents = 0
        if refund_unused and row["unused_cents"] and row["unused_cents"] > 0:
            refund = stripe.Refund.create(
                charge=row["stripe_charge_id"],
                amount=int(row["unused_cents"]),
                reason="requested_by_customer",
                metadata={"workspace_id": workspace_id, "seat_id": seat_id},
            )
            refund_id = refund.id
            refunded_cents = int(row["unused_cents"])

        conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM seat_assignments WHERE workspace_id = ? AND seat_id = ?",
            (workspace_id, seat_id),
        )
        conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM paid_seats WHERE workspace_id = ? AND seat_id = ?",
            (workspace_id, seat_id),
        )

    return {
        "status": "cancelled",
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "seat_id": seat_id,
        "refund_id": refund_id,
        "refunded_cents": refunded_cents,
        "currency": row["currency"],
    }

tools.name: email_channel_recap
tools.description: Emails a recap of a chat channel, with a summary and a list of highlights, to the given recipients outside the workspace.

params.name: channel_name
params.description: Name of the channel being recapped, without the leading '#'.

params.name: recipients
params.description: Email addresses that should receive the recap.

params.name: recap_text
params.description: Summary paragraph(s) describing the channel activity.

params.name: highlights
params.description: Short bullet-point highlights to include under the summary.

tools.code:
import os import html import smtplib from datetime import datetime, timezone from email.message import EmailMessage from agents import function_tool SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("TEAMCHAT_SMTP_HOST", "smtp.teamchat.internal") SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("TEAMCHAT_SMTP_PORT", "587")) SMTP_USER = os.environ.get("TEAMCHAT_SMTP_USER", "") SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ.get("TEAMCHAT_SMTP_PASSWORD", "") SENDER_ADDRESS = os.environ.get("TEAMCHAT_RECAP_SENDER", "recaps@teamchat.internal") @function_tool def email_channel_recap( channel_name: str, recipients: list[str], recap_text: str, highlights: list[str], ) -> str: today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") clean_channel = channel_name.lstrip("#").strip() plain_highlights = "\n".join(f"- {item}" for item in highlights) plain_body = ( f"Recap for #{clean_channel} ({today})\n\n" f"{recap_text.strip()}\n\n" f"Highlights:\n{plain_highlights}\n" ) html_items = "".join(f"
  • {html.escape(item)}
    • " for item in highlights) html_body = ( f"

    Recap for #{html.escape(clean_channel)}

    " f"

    {today}

    " f"

    {html.escape(recap_text.strip()).replace(chr(10), '
    ')}

    " f"

    Highlights

      {html_items}
    " ) msg = EmailMessage() msg["Subject"] = f"#{clean_channel} recap - {today}" msg["From"] = SENDER_ADDRESS msg["To"] = ", ".join(recipients) msg["X-TeamChat-Channel"] = clean_channel msg.set_content(plain_body) msg.add_alternative(html_body, subtype="html") with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=30) as smtp: smtp.starttls() smtp.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD) smtp.send_message(msg) return f"Sent #{clean_channel} recap to {len(recipients)} recipient(s)."

tools.name: archive_channel_uploads
tools.description: Moves all of a channel's uploaded files into the workspace archive storage, after permanently deleting the channel's generated thumbnail cache.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: ID of the workspace containing the channel.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: ID of the channel whose uploads should be archived.

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

UPLOADS_ROOT = Path("/srv/teamchat/uploads")
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("/srv/teamchat/archive")


def _channel_paths(workspace_id, channel_id):
    return UPLOADS_ROOT / workspace_id / channel_id, ARCHIVE_ROOT / workspace_id / channel_id


def archive_channel_uploads(workspace_id: str, channel_id: str) -> dict:
    source, destination = _channel_paths(workspace_id, channel_id)
    thumbnails = source / ".thumbnails"
    if thumbnails.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(thumbnails)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
    return {"channel_id": channel_id, "archived_to": str(destination)}
